title: RLS Statement Vocabulary
description: Marker vocabulary for statements the group takes a stance on (Resonance module). It introduces no own data properties: the statement sentence lives in the base/v1 `title`, optional context in `description`. Carrying this vocabulary activates the item for the Resonance module and the feed union (spec 06, marker vocabularies).

title.description: The statement itself — one sentence (base/v1 term, required by this vocabulary).
